Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pihu - 8 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Kavita - 41 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Vikram - 42 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Kavita, Vikram and Pihu stand near him.]

Aditya: "Pihu, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya jumps with joy.]

Vikram: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "Show me too!"

[Aditya climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Aditya (gently): "What happened?"

[Aditya hides behind the tree.]

Aditya (excited): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aditya searches for his lost ball.]

Aditya (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Aditya peeks out from behind the door.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Vikram: "Kavita, look over here."

[Pihu puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya irons his school shirt.]

Aditya: "Pihu, listen!"

[Aditya studies for his exam.]

Vikram: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
